senses.gloss:
मुमुक्षु मुमुक्षु, i. e. मुमुक्ष, desider. of मुच्, + उ,
 I. adj.
 1. Desiring to dart (viz. arrows), Ragh. 9, 58.
 2. Anxious for liberation from mundane existence or final beatitude, Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 22; Vikr. d. 1.
 II. m. A sage abstracted from all human passion.
मुमुक्षुत्व मुमुक्षु + त्व, n. Condition of one who is anxious for final beatitude; wishing for final beatitude, Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 7.
मुमूर्षा मुमूर्षा, i. e. मुमूर्ष, desider. of मृ, + अ, f. Desire to die, MBh. 1, 1899.
मुमूर्षु मुमूर्षु, i. e. मुमूर्ष, desider. of मृ, + उ, adj. Being about to die, Hit. 64, 8; Rājat. 5, 218; 411.
